messages:
samir: Quick follow-up from Avalon's postmortem — root cause looks like an asymmetric ACL change on their on‑prem firewall that dropped peering keepalives; Dedicated nodes interpreted the loss as isolation and triggered failover. Need clear owners for remediation items. TL;DR below. @maria can you take net changes validation?

maria: Yep, I can take that. I'll add a validation step to the onboarding checklist and open a runbook PR. ETA EOD Thu. I've created INF-4321 and will add subtasks.

liam: I'll own the infra-side mitigation: add passive keepalive detection + graceful fallback to regional replica when we see sustained keepalive loss. Branching from infra/peering-detect. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/infra/pulls/486. ETA Mon.

dina: I'll handle customer comms and the verification window with Avalon. Planning a joint test next Tue, 02:00 UTC — will that work for you all? @samir pls confirm.

samir: That time works. Also adding a CI smoke test that runs after deploy: run the internal healthcheck and assert peering_state==connected for 5m. Example command to include in CI:
```
curl -sS https://internal.healthcheck/peering?tenant=avalon | jq -r '.peering_state' | grep connected
```
I'll add this to the deployment CI job and link in INF-4321.

sre-jay: I'll add the new steps to the peering runbook (/runbooks/vpc-peering) and put playbook troubleshooting steps for asymmetric ACLs. Noting recurring pattern: similar flaps on 2024-07-11 and 2025-01-19 — recommend a quarterly peering audit. I'll create INF-4322 for audit cadence.

oncall-bot: Reminder: INF-4321 due 2026-03-30. Next check-in scheduled: 1928610000.

maria: Summarizing action items so we don't lose track: 1) FW change validation step in onboarding (owner: maria) 2) Runbook & playbook updates (owner: sre-jay) 3) Infra passive-detection & fallback (owner: liam) 4) Customer verification session + calendar invite (owner: dina) 5) CI smoke test (owner: samir). I'll update INF-4321 subtasks and add acceptance criteria.

liam: :thumbsup: I'll gate the change behind a feature flag and include metrics for keepalive drops in Grafana.

dina: Sending calendar invite now and attaching the test checklist. cc @jess for on-call support during the window.

samir: I've added owners/subtasks to INF-4321 and created INF-4322 for the quarterly audit. Closing loop: we'll consider this resolved once all PRs merge and we observe 1 week of stability post-merge. If anything blocks, post here and I'll escalate. :white_check_mark:
